provenanceNote: Starting hypotheses written from public provider documentation and community experience — not benchmarked claims. PromptLoop refines these through your feedback, in your browser.

fields.instruction_style: Simple, short instructions; long rule lists get partially dropped
fields.reasoning_trigger: Explicit chain-of-thought helps on most non-trivial tasks
fields.format_adherence: Medium — give an example record and expect to validate output
fields.role_sensitivity: Persona helps tone more than accuracy
fields.context_placement: Keep the total prompt short; the end of the prompt gets the most attention

house_rules.text: Cap the rules to the essential five
Say 'no preamble — output only the X' when you want clean output
Put the output format specification last

failure_modes: Adds a friendly preamble unless forbidden
Drops constraints when there are more than about seven
